response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT ordersmark AS order_reference, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), shares AS (SELECT order_reference, execution_count, 1.0 * execution_count / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), results AS (SELECT order_reference, execution_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference FROM shares) SELECT order_reference, execution_count, share, share_difference FROM results ORDER BY share_difference IS NULL, share_difference DESC LIMIT 10
